Team —

Quick note ahead of EOD: finance ran the coverage vs quota numbers and theres a clear shortfall if we dont get stage hygiene tightened and a few medium-size deals committed. Summary: 
- Q1 bookings target: $3.5M
- Coverage target (3.2x): $11.2M required pipeline
- Current weighted pipeline (open + best case): $7.8M
- Gap: $3.4M

Ive attached the working tracker (coverage_gap_tracker.xlsx) and exported current HubSpot rows for the deals I flagged. Action items:
1) Owners — update stage to the most current, move deals into "Commit" only if contract signatures/clear exec approvals are present.
2) Mark the confidence (Low/Med/High) in the tracker and add expected close date.
3) If a deal is going to slip to next quarter, mark the expected ARR impact and owner.

Specific asks for today: please update the sheet and HubSpot for any deals >$100k and change the status for any deals you believe will close this quarter to "Commit" (only if you have explicit next-step evidence). I will roll up and send a reconciliation to Finance and CRO tomorrow morning.

Links:
- Coverage sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aB3cCoverageSheet/edit#gid=0
- Export: attached hubspot-export-1193.csv

If you need help triaging which deals to prioritize, call out the 3 that matter most and Ill help reallocate AE time.

Thanks —
